templates.sound table row: only inside the 'Sounds' heading, itself excluded (excluded.sections) as a game asset like Audio; the audio table itself isn't modelled
templates.sound table header: only inside the 'Sounds' heading, same reason as sound table row
templates.without context: the wiki's own wrapper for 'ignore the page context here', only inside Trivia on Lilith's page, discarded by decision 9
templates.dlc_: a one-time typo of {{dlc|r+}} on Spirit Sword; not silently corrected, the edition badge is lost
templates.#ev:twitchvod: commented out (<!-- --> ) on the Items page; MediaWiki never renders it, and this parser's own comment strip runs before any template match — dead text, not a video embed
templates.#vardefine: item pool#is devil: a MediaWiki parser function that stores a value for later use on the page; nothing it stores is game content. On Devil Room (Item Pool), where the page's own prose already says which room the pool belongs to
templates.bugs table: a Cargo query listing every {{bug|…}} template site-wide; the individual bugs are already read from their own {{bug|…}} on each item's page, and the Bugs page itself names no manual list to read instead
templates.character tables: a Cargo-generated character roster on the Characters page; each character's own infobox already carries this page's data, and the page names no manual list to read instead
templates.trophy list: a Cargo-generated achievement roster on the Achievements page; the achievements are already read from their own infoboxes, and the page names no manual list to read instead
templates.collection page: the site's visual recreation of the in-game collection-grid page (Collection Page and its per-edition variants), listing every item in grid order for a layout this parser doesn't reproduce; every item it names is already a full entry in the items collection
templates.item pool: the pool's own summary box (a price-type parameter only) on the Item Pool articles; one field, declined the same way decision 2 declines the card/rune/pickup/stage infoboxes' own parameters rather than adding an IPC field for it
templates.dlcset: a Cargo-query filter fragment (the set of DLC codes for an edition), substituted into a collectible/trinket/achievement/challenge/transformation table's where= clause; it carries a query parameter, not reader text
templates./additions: MediaWiki's relative-subpage transclusion syntax; the subpage it transcludes ('<page>/Additions') is already fetched and read as its own article, so nothing is lost, only spliced twice by the wiki's own page structure
templates./changes: MediaWiki's relative-subpage transclusion syntax; the subpage it transcludes ('<page>/Changes') would already be fetched and read as its own article if it existed in this snapshot, so nothing is lost, only spliced twice by the wiki's own page structure
templates.afterbirth babies: a Cargo-generated co-op character table on 'The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth/Additions'; no positional list to read, and the page's 'Co-op' section has no other content
